subject: Co-host opportunity: CloudForward mini-roundtable at Inference Summit
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@edgenova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-host opportunity: CloudForward mini-roundtable at Inference Summit

Hi Priyom + Marissa,

EdgeNova is running a curated "mini-roundtable" segment inside the CloudForward Inference Summit (Dec 8-9). We program three 30-minute vendor panels each day — tight, high-intent audience (~200 qualified buyers per session). We think Redwood would be a strong co-host for a session about "Productionizing Open Models: Cost, Latency, and Safeguards."

High level proposal:
- Co-host a 30-min panel + 10-min audience Q&A (Redwood gets 2 speaker slots).
- Shared tabletop presence in the partner cluster (6ft table + 2 stools).
- EdgeNova asks for a $7,500 co-marketing contribution (covers partner cluster costs, attendee nurture, and shared leads).
- Lead handling: capture by QR + CSV export; we can do an inbound webhook to your CRM or provide a CSV.

Would Redwood be interested? If so, can we:
1) Confirm speaker names and who will staff the tabletop.
2) Agree on contribution and legal (we can send a short MOU).
3) Schedule a 20-min sync this week to finalize logistics.

Attaching the event one-pager and a sample MOU template for reference.

Cheers,
Samantha Li
Partnerships Manager, EdgeNova Events
attachments: EdgeNova_OnePager.pdf, CloudForward_Event_TOS.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@edgenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-host opportunity: CloudForward mini-roundtable at Inference Summit

Samantha — thanks for the note and the packet. This sounds useful for our Q4 push.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes, interested. Proposed speakers: me (product/partnerships) + Ben Carter (field). We can also consider a customer success angle if you think it helps.
- $7,500 contribution sounds reasonable but need to confirm cost split on tabletop staff travel. Can we clarify what that contribution covers vs any separate exhibitor fees?
- Lead routing: we prefer an inbound webhook to our HubSpot instance, but CSV works as fallback. We can provide the routing template.

Next steps from our side:
1) I attached a short draft MOU that clarifies deliverables, lead format, branding approvals, and cancellation terms (CloudForward_MOU_Draft_v1.pdf). Please review and mark any redlines.
2) Can you share the final booth footprint (photo/layout) and shipping deadlines?
3) Let's do a 20-min call Thu 11/5 at 10:00 PT or Fri 11/6 at 9:00 PT — which works?

I'll loop Ben on logistics in my follow-up.

Best,
Priyom Das
Partner Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: CloudForward_MOU_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Li <samantha@edgenova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-host opportunity: CloudForward mini-roundtable at Inference Summit

Thanks, Priyom and Samantha — looping Ben so he can confirm staffing. A couple of operational clarifications from field ops:

- Tabletop staffing: we typically send 1 dedicated rep + 1 floater. If EdgeNova's partner cluster limits to one rep per company, we need to know now so we can prioritize Ben for the in-person slot.
- Cost split: suggest we do 60/40 (EdgeNova/Redwood) on the partner-cluster direct costs if EdgeNova is handling booth build and lead capture. The $7.5k can be considered the contribution toward shared marketing/nurture and should sit on top of any per-company exhibitor fee. Please confirm.
- Badge allocation: we need 3 exhibitor badges for Redwood (speaker + 2 staff). Confirm by 11/12 so we can book travel.
- Lead sharing: we require PII handling to be spelled out (consent toggles). Our compliance team needs the lead capture form copy; send it to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com.

Samantha — one thing on the MOU: please add a clause for logo approval timeline (48 hours after submission) and a simple termination schedule (30 days out with refund of unspent funds). I've annotated the draft and left comments in the PDF.

Thanks — Ben, can you confirm you can cover the tabletop staffing if we move forward?

—Marissa
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
attachments: (annotated) CloudForward_MOU_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Samantha Li <samantha@edgenova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-host opportunity: CloudForward mini-roundtable at Inference Summit

All — great to see alignment. Quick updates:

- We can accommodate 2 staffers at the partner cluster (so Ben + 1 works).
- Confirming the $7,500 co-marketing contribution as proposed; exhibitor fee (per-company) is separate and currently $1,200 — EdgeNova will invoice Redwood for the co-marketing contribution and the exhibitor fee will be billed via the standard exhibitor portal.
- I've uploaded our logo package and a templated lead CSV to the shared Drive (link below). Attaching EdgeNova_Logo_Vector.zip and EN-Lead-Routing-Template.csv here for quick reference.
- DocuSign: I created a short MOU envelope — please review and sign. Link: https://docusign.com/en/Envelope/12345abcde. We included the logo approval and 30-day termination language per Marissa's request.

Action items:
- Priyom/Marissa: please sign the DocuSign by 11/12 to lock badges and tabletop allocation.
- Ben: confirm travel (I'll send shipping docs and a quick exhibitor checklist once you're confirmed).
- Marissa: I'll send the final lead-capture copy to your email later today.

Looking forward to working with Redwood on this session — we'll aim to drive the panel audience from our enterprise attendee list (targeted invites).

Thanks,
Samantha
Partnerships Manager, EdgeNova Events
